description: A CSS module defining styles for a Button component, including base styles, size variations, and visual states such as hover and focus.

classes.name: buttonBase
classes.description: Base styles for the button including layout, font properties, and interactivity.

classes.name: sm
classes.description: Style for small buttons, adjusting font size and padding.

classes.name: md
classes.description: Style for medium buttons, adjusting font size and padding.

classes.name: lg
classes.description: Style for large buttons, adjusting font size and padding.

classes.name: primary
classes.description: Styles for primary buttons ensuring distinct background and color with hover effects.

classes.name: secondary
classes.description: Styles for secondary buttons providing a different color scheme and hover effects.

classes.name: success
classes.description: Styles for success buttons to indicate positive actions.

classes.name: danger
classes.description: Styles for danger buttons which indicate destructive actions.

classes.name: ghost
classes.description: Styles for ghost buttons, typically with a transparent background.

classes.name: fullWidth
classes.description: Styles for buttons that take the full width of their container.

classes.name: disabled
classes.description: Styles for disabled buttons to indicate unavailability.

classes.name: spinner
classes.description: Animation styles for a loading spinner associated with the button.

classes.name: focusVisible
classes.description: Styles for focus-visible indication using a box-shadow.
